idea: Pick a random edge and merge its two ends into one node, again and again, until two nodes remain. The edges between them are a cut. One run finds the minimum cut with a fair chance, so repeat it and keep the smallest cut.
time: O(V^2) per run; about V^2 log V runs for high confidence
useWhen: Finding the fewest edges whose removal splits a network in two
Showing how a simple random choice can solve a hard-looking problem
avoidWhen: You need a result you can be sure of after one run: it may return a cut that is not the smallest
The graph is disconnected: the minimum cut is already 0
